prediction_unit: image, uncertainty summarized by patient-cluster bootstrap where available
candidate_selection: highest validation average precision; validation is selection-exposed and is not treated as an independent estimate

calibration.source: patient-disjoint 20% subset sampled deterministically from official training patients

official_test.access: prohibited in this resumed development run; test was evaluated in an earlier campaign

interpretation: Single-center 133-degree ultra-widefield development data; not clinical validation, not standard-camera transfer, not an autonomous diagnosis. RVO is a broad label in this source and does not resolve BRVO versus CRVO.
